pageTitle: "Coordinates of Clear Frost" Mika Is Here! Participate in the Event to Win Merchandise~
name: "Coordinates of Clear Frost" Mika Is Here! Participate in the Event to Win Merchandise~
description: Olah! Hello, Travelers~ Today, we will be introducing Mika, the Front-Line Land Surveyor of the Knights of Favonius. As a member of the Knights of Favonius Reconnaissance Company, Mika always diligently fulfills all the duties that come his way. Setting up tents, lighting fires for cooking, repairing equipment... Even Hertha, the logistics captain, has nothing but praise for Mika's excellent efficiency. What a reliable Front-Line Land Surveyor Mika is! Becoming a member of Knights of Favonius Reconnaissance Company must open the door to lot of amazing adventures! Traveler, if you have a chance to go on adventures with the Knights of Favonius Reconnaissance Company, which unknown area would you choose to explore? Remember to record the details of landscape data with Mika!
